import math

    tot=sum(cnt.values())
    freqs={c:seq.count(c)/n for c in "ACGT"}
    rows=[]
    for mer,c in cnt.items():
        p=1.0
        for ch in mer: p*=freqs[ch]
        exp=tot*p
        var=tot*p*(1-p)
        z=(c-exp)/math.sqrt(var) if var>0 else 0
        rows.append((z,mer,c,exp))
    rows.sort(reverse=True)
    print(f"-- k={k}: top overrepresented --")
    for z,mer,c,exp in rows[:5]:
